svg.title: yinwu01 — HIRE ME !Plz snake animation
svg.desc: Words fade in with five dark-theme shades matching the underlying dates' real contribution levels, then a snake eats only the decorative letter pixels. Zero-contribution letters retain a readable floor. The real contribution backdrop stays unchanged. 9.5 second loop. Reduced motion shows the first word. Data source: github-public-calendar.
svg.text: Real contributions stay · words come and go
